sources.title: 2026 Packet OW-2 Oklahoma Income Tax Withholding Tables

calculation.marriedHigherSingleRate: Use the Single schedule when the employee selects Married, but withhold at higher Single rate on OK-W-4.

supplementalWages.capturedTreatment: No separate supplemental-wage method appears in the 2026 OW-2; payments subject to withholding use the selected percentage formula or wage-bracket method.

residencyAndWorkRules.generalRule: Withholding applies to compensation for services rendered in Oklahoma unless a statutory exclusion applies.

nonresidentQuarterlyDeMinimis.effect: Services performed in Oklahoma by a nonresident individual are excluded when quarterly income is not more than the threshold.

otherExclusions: Farm services when monthly pay is $900 or less
Domestic services in a private home, local college, club, or local college fraternity or sorority chapter
Services outside the employer's trade or business unless quarterly cash remuneration is $200 or more
residencyAndWorkRules.productionLoanOutRule: For services performed in Oklahoma, production companies or payroll providers must withhold at the highest statutory percentage rate on payments to loan-out companies and allocate withholding to the loan-out company's employees.

remittanceSchedules.condition: Quarterly withholding over $500 but prior-year monthly amount under $5,000
Federal semiweekly depositor or average monthly taxes at least $10,000 in prior fiscal year
remittanceSchedules.due: Same dates as federal semiweekly deposits

captureWarnings: The official example first says $12.19 plus 4.5 percent, but its table, arithmetic, and final result use the official $9.10 base; the capture preserves $9.10 and records the publication typo.
The complete wage-bracket matrices remain in the checksummed official publication rather than being duplicated here.
No distinct supplemental-wage method or resident-working-outside-Oklahoma rule was located in OW-2.

review.requiredNextStep: Verify supplemental and resident out-of-state treatment from controlling law, import all direct tables, and add bracket, rounding, de-minimis, loan-out, and filing regressions.
